latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of autoresearch: Autonomous experiment loop for AI agents.

- Adds commands for interactive setup, experiment loop, and result analysis.
- Enforces one-variable-at-a-time discipline and uses Git history as an experiment notebook.
- Guides users through defining experiment goals, metrics, constraints, and setup.
- Automates experiment runs, metric extraction, result logging, and decision logic (keep/discard/crash).
- Encourages systematic exploration, learning from past commits, and creative experimentation within user-defined boundaries.
